one_line_pitch: AI-powered platform connecting academic researchers with industry R&D teams.
problem_statement: Independent academic researchers struggle to commercialise their findings. Industry R&D teams lack visibility into early-stage academic work before it becomes publicly published.
proposed_solution: A matchmaking platform that uses NLP to analyse research papers and match them with relevant corporate R&D departments, enabling early licensing and collaboration conversations.
target_market: Life sciences, materials science, and deep tech researchers at US and EU universities. Estimated 120,000 active R&D-publishing academics annually.
business_model: SaaS subscription for corporate R&D teams ($500/month per team seat). Universities pay a platform fee for bulk researcher access.
competitive_landscape: Existing tools like ResearchGate and Academia.edu focus on paper sharing, not commercialisation. No direct competitor addresses early-stage licensing facilitation.
technical_status: Proof-of-concept NLP pipeline built in Python. No production infrastructure yet.
